actions.text: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

dimensions.assessment: Affects the Great Lakes Commission and member states in the Great Lakes region.
dimensions.evidence: The Great Lakes Commission... comprised of the States of Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Minnesota, Wisconsin, New York, Ohio, and Pennsylvania.

dimensions.assessment: A formal statutory designation change for an existing commission.
dimensions.evidence: To designate the Great Lakes Commission as a Regional Great Lakes Partnership

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, revenue changes, or specific appropriations are stated.
Amends a single paragraph of an existing public law to include the commission as a regional partnership.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10202(b)(3) of the James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023... is amended

missing_information: Any associated funding or grant eligibility tied to the new designation.
importance_detail.rationale: Designates the Great Lakes Commission as a Regional Great Lakes Partnership under an existing defense authorization act.
